faqLeft.q: What engine does the Range Rover Evoque P250 use?
faqLeft.a: The Evoque P250 uses the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine. It was introduced in 2016 with the L538 generation facelift and continues into the current L551 model.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Range Rover Evoque P250 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, for either generation. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Evoque P250?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ingenium AJ200P Evoque P250 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ200P rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Evoque P250 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Evoque P250 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an Evoque P250 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Evoque P250 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
